copy.title: Campus Events
copy.lede: Everything happening around Xavier Ateneo, newest first. Tap any event for the full details and where it is being held.
copy.emptyBody: Check back soon — events are added here as organizations confirm them.

events.title: The Xavier Cup — Opening Ceremony
events.description: The parade of colleges, the lighting of the season torch, and the first whistle of the Xavier Cup. Every college marches; the opening exhibition match follows straight after.

events.title: Campus Org Fair
events.description: Two days, every accredited organization, one quad. Walk the tents, talk to the officers, and sign up on the spot. Campus Compass has the full map of who is standing where.

events.title: DevFest Workshop Series
events.description: A full afternoon of hands-on sessions on modern web, cloud and AI tooling, run by the student developer community. Bring a laptop; no prior experience assumed.

events.title: Kalinga Community Outreach
events.description: A day of community immersion and relief packing with partner barangays. Volunteers meet at the Chapel car park before the convoy leaves.

events.title: Acquaintance Party
events.description: The first big night of the term — performances from each college, and the announcement of the Xavier Cup draw.
